title: Professional Business Communication
quote: Martin was very interactive and made sure that everyone was involved despite the barriers that virtual sessions present. He also related to real life examples 'e.g. in a partner training session they said x,y,z' which was nice to hear that trainee training is also being replicated on a partner level. It was a long session, but I was not time watching and felt engaged with each section, which is a great achievement for Martin.
author: Emma Buchanan
subject: Professional Business Communication
